questions.stem: Why do sieve tube elements have very few organelles and no nucleus?

options.text: So there is more space for dissolved sugars to flow through them
Because they are dead cells like xylem vessels
To allow water to pass through their walls more easily
Because they do not need energy for any function

questions.explanation: Sieve tube elements have reduced cell contents (no nucleus and very few organelles) so that dissolved sugars can flow through them with minimal obstruction. They are still living cells, unlike xylem vessels.
